inherited_release_gate.note: All prior extraction/rendering/audio/route/camera/mobile/code-lineage and dev22 native-builder gates are inherited. dev23 adds project-level mod orchestration and real retail no-op round-trip validation without modifying sealed dev22.

dev23_real_corpus_roundtrip.scope: user-supplied retail Xbox 360 external corpus; proprietary inputs not bundled
dev23_real_corpus_roundtrip.boundary: No-op byte identity proves lossless reconstruction on tested retail samples; arbitrary modified-asset runtime acceptance remains a separate gate.

asset_functionalization.note: Coverage count is unchanged from dev22; dev23 connects existing native builders through one mod-workspace workflow.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, audited before executing package code, and passed 68/68 selftests. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording these candidate results and revalidated separately.

limitations: PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented; mod-build emits verified decompressed BBX for SDAT-backed resources.
GMX native editing remains template-preserving and fixed-layout; arbitrary topology/count/chunk-graph synthesis is not claimed.
Retail GMX/localization byte-identical no-op rebuilds do not by themselves prove runtime acceptance of arbitrary modifications.
Xbox XACT/XMA2 and PS3 SBlk/VAG/989SND banks decode to common audio but do not yet have native replacement-bank builders.
Xenos shader containers expose bounded raw microcode and metadata; ISA disassembly/translation/compilation remains unresolved.
